To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a collaborative recommendation system can be designed to support e learning, and 2) a hybrid model that combines collaborative and content-based strategies can be successfully implemented in order to provide a high degree of personalisation.

the cascade of recommendation strategies can be applied to a variety of learning objects and that it is possible to improve the performance of a recommender system by combining the collaborative and content based approaches in a hybrid model.

the proposed recommendation cascade can be used to support the learning processes of learners with different learning styles, and that the accuracy of the prediction of the system is improved by combining content and collaborative approaches.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of a collaborative recommendation model that is based on a combination of personalised and non personalised approaches.
the development of a recommendation system that exploits a variety of strategies to support the learning processes of learners.

a hybrid recommendation system that implements the following cascade of strategies: (i) personalised, (ii) implicit and explicit profiles, (iii) non personalisation, (iv) collaborative, and (v) content based.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a collaborative recommendation system based on a cascade of strategies, and that takes into account the implicit and explicit personalisation, and the non personalised modes, can improve the learning process.
the proposed approach is a promising one for the development of a recommender system for E-learning, which is able to provide a high quality of service.
this recommendation system has a potential to be used in e learning environments.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a novel recommendation system that is based on the combination of the collaborative filtering technique with content based filtering, and on the integration of explicit and implicit profiles.
we have developed a recommendation system that combines content and collaborative approaches to provide a personalised service to the learners.
we propose a recommendation system that is based on the collaborative approach and on the hybrid approach, and which is capable of supporting the process of learning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a cascade of strategies is more accurate than a single strategy, and the accuracy of the recommendation system improves as the number of learners increases.
it is possible to build an effective recommendation engine for e-learning that takes advantage of the collaborative and the non personalisation modes of interaction.
the cascade approach to recommendation is a viable solution for the recommendation of learning objects.
